appSubtitle: Convert ornitho exports into eBird checklists
ebirdLanguageHelp: Used to match ornitho species names to your eBird language.
partySizeHelp: Default number of observers for newly created checklists.
aggregationSettingsHelp: Same-day sightings are grouped into the same checklist when they stay within both the time and distance limits below.
advancedModeSimpleBody: After importing the file, the app will automatically group sightings into checklists. Any changes to checklist metadata can only be made in eBird after import.
advancedModeCustomBody: In Customized mode, you will be able to (1) customize the assignment of sightings into checklists and (2) modify checklist metadata easily through the app.
mapboxTokenHelp: Use a public Mapbox token with the styles:tiles scope if you want static map generation.
staticMapEnabled: Include static map in checklist comment

infoDescription: Ornitho2eBird converts exports from ornitho websites, Observation websites and BirdLasser into eBird-ready checklists.
infoHowItWorksIntro: The app handles imported lists and individual sightings differently.
infoHowItWorksChecklistIntro: The use of lists in ornitho, even incomplete ones, makes the conversion much easier and is therefore strongly recommended.
infoHowItWorksChecklistPointOne: Easy conversion into eBird checklists because almost all metadata is already available.
infoHowItWorksChecklistPointTwo: Using the track in Naturalist is strongly recommended so checklist distance can be carried over automatically. Without distance, checklists become historical in eBird.
infoHowItWorksChecklistPointThree: Number of observers is not recorded in ornitho, so the app uses the default value defined in Settings.
infoHowItWorksChecklistPointFour: The app assumes that if you submitted a list, birding was the primary purpose.
infoHowItWorksSightingsIntro: Single records need to be grouped into checklists before export.
infoHowItWorksSightingsPointOne: The app uses an automatic aggregation, see below for details.
infoHowItWorksSightingsPointTwo: In Customized mode, you can review and manually adjust these generated checklists before export.
infoHowItWorksSightingsPointThree: These checklists are marked as primary purpose by default.
infoHowItWorksSightingsPointFour: These checklists are not considered complete by default.
infoAutoAssignIntro: Sighting aggregation automatically groups non-assigned incidental sightings into new checklists.
infoAutoAssignPointTwo: Two sightings can be grouped only if they are on the same calendar day and within both the distance and duration thresholds. Aggregation never spans midnight.
infoAutoAssignPointThree: Grouping is transitive: if A matches B and B matches C, all three can end up in the same checklist.
infoAutoAssignPointFour: Aggregation creates new checklists only. It does not add sightings to existing checklists.
infoAutoAssignPointFive: If no time is available, the sighting is treated as 00:00. With the default 24-hour duration threshold, same-day aggregation is therefore driven mainly by distance.
infoAutoAssignPointSix: The duration and distance thresholds can be adjusted in Settings.
introWorkflowImport: Export the data you want to import from the source website, for example ornitho.ch.
introWorkflowLoad: Import this file into the web app.
introWorkflowAggregation: Customized view only: adjust how sightings are aggregated into checklists.
introWorkflowMetadata: Customized view only: adjust checklist metadata such as duration, distance, and related details.
introWorkflowExport: Download the eBird Record Format CSV generated by the app.
introWorkflowEbirdImport: Go to the eBird import page and upload the CSV.
introWorkflowReview: After import, review checklist locations, hotspot matches and species names in eBird.
prerequisiteLabel: Before continuing, confirm that you understand:
importantRuleOne: Mapping protocols from ornitho, BirdLasser or Observation to eBird is not always exact. Complete stationary or traveling checklists are preferred when you can provide effort details.
importantRuleTwo: Keeping a link to the original sighting in species comments can help eBird reviewers validate records.
importantRuleThree: For pre-eBird life list imports that do not meet current eBird checklist rules, consolidate data carefully and review the import afterward.
importFileOrnitho: Import the JSON file exported from ornitho.ch
importHelpOrnitho: Export the JSON file of the data you want to convert. Use the link below to get directly the data you need.
importHelpObservation: Open the Observations page, export your records as CSV, then import that CSV file here.
importHelpBirdlasser: Export your records from BirdLasser as CSV, then import that CSV file here.
importHelpOrnithoNet: Open 'All my sightings', keep the website in English, export the results as TXT, then import that TXT file here.
websiteWarning: The first record does not seem to match {website}. First location detected: {location}.
taxonomicIssueBody: Some species could not be matched to the selected eBird language. The CSV can still be exported, but you may need to fix species names during eBird import.
speciesCodePrompt: Enter the matching eBird species code
advancedIntro: Automatic grouping is already applied. Use this section to review each checklist, adjust metadata, draw a path when needed, and choose what to export before importing into eBird.
assignmentIntro: Use the map to create checklists or reassign incidental sightings between checklists before export. A sighting joins a checklist when it is on the same calendar day and within both the duration and distance thresholds of at least one sighting already in that checklist.
assignmentWarning: Sightings under "0. Non-assigned" will not be exported.
assignmentMagicTooltip: Automatically group non-assigned sightings using the duration and distance settings below.
createChecklistTooltip: Draw a rectangle on the map to create a new checklist from the sightings inside it.
assignToChecklistTooltip: Draw a rectangle on the map to assign the sightings inside it to the selected checklist.
assignResetTooltip: Delete all created checklist assignments and start again.
assignResetConfirm: Are you sure you want to reset checklist assignment? This cannot be undone.
assignDurationLongConfirm: The selected duration is longer than recommended. Do you want to continue anyway?
assignDurationTooLong: The selected duration is too long.
assignDistanceLongConfirm: The selected distance is longer than recommended. Do you want to continue anyway?
assignDistanceTooLong: The selected distance is too long.
assignNoSightings: There are no non-assigned sightings left to assign.
assignNoSightingsInSelection: No sightings were found inside the selected rectangle. Draw the selection over sightings and try again.
warningMultipleDays: This checklist contains sightings from different days and should be split before export.
warningInvalid: This checklist is invalid for export. A date is required and duration must stay below one day.
speciesCommentTemplateHelp: Add sighting-specific information to the eBird species comments, such as group size, exact position, time of observation, or a link to the original ornitho platform.
speciesCommentTemplateAdvancedHelp: Use HTML/JS code in the template to customize the comment. Use the notation ${'{'} javascript code {'}'} to insert dynamic information for each sighting. You can access sighting-level values with ${'{'} s.property {'}'}, using the properties listed in the table below.
longTemplateHelp: When you have many sightings of the same species, we recommend using the long template to optimise space use. Set your threshold below.
switchLimitError: Threshold must be a whole number greater than or equal to 1.
multipleSightingsBody: When a species is recorded multiple times, we add the count and associated comment in a new line.
updatePathConfirm: Update the checklist path and set distance to {next} km?

focusMapTooltip: Select a hotspot from the map below if appropriate.
